events.title: Krakow Restaurant Week, autumn 2026
events.desc: Fixed-price set menus at 54 Krakow restaurants, booked online by date and time. We went through the whole list and picked the twelve worth booking.

events.title: ENOEXPO international wine fair
events.price: Aimed at the wine trade, check entry rules with the organiser
events.desc: Poland's big international wine fair, held together with the HORECA show: tastings, master classes and the Polish Wine and Cider Competition results. Mostly for importers and restaurants, so confirm visitor access before you go.

events.title: Art & Food Bazar at Stary Kleparz
events.desc: A Sunday food and design fair inside the city's oldest market, with street food, local producers and makers' stalls.

events.title: Christmas market on the Main Square
events.venue: Rynek Główny, the Main Market Square
events.desc: Grilled oscypek, kiełbasa, pierogi, bigos and mulled wine from wooden stalls on the Main Square. The organiser has not announced 2026 dates yet; last year it ran from 28 November to 1 January.

events.title: Art & Food Bazar at Stary Kleparz
events.desc: The last edition of the season, on Saint Nicholas Day: street food, local producers and makers' stalls inside the market.
